title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 30: the Amalekites burn Ziklag, and David pursues them and recovers everything that was taken.

questions.text: On which day did David and his men come to Ziklag?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 30:1 says David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day.

questions.text: Who had raided Ziklag and burned it with fire?
questions.explanation: The Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, struck Ziklag and burned it with fire.

questions.text: What did the grieving people speak of doing to David?
questions.explanation: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because every man was grieved for his sons and daughters.

questions.text: Whom did David ask to bring him the ephod?
questions.explanation: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Please bring the ephod here to me."

questions.text: Why did two hundred men stay behind at the brook Besor?
questions.explanation: Two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn't go over the brook Besor.

answers.text: They were too faint to cross the brook
They were sent to warn Achish

questions.text: What did they give the Egyptian they found in the field, besides bread and water?
questions.explanation: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins.

answers.text: Part of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins
Roasted meat and a full skin of wine
A bowl of red lentil stew and bread
Honey, milk, and a measure of parched grain

questions.text: Whose servant was the young man of Egypt?
questions.explanation: He said, "I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite," and his master had left him because he got sick.

questions.text: Who escaped when David struck the Amalekites?
questions.explanation: Not a man of them escaped, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

answers.text: Four hundred young men on camels

questions.text: What rule did David make about the plunder?
questions.explanation: David said that as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage: they shall share alike.

answers.text: Only those who fought receive any plunder
Those who stay with the baggage share alike
All of the plunder goes to the king alone
The plunder is burned as an offering

questions.text: To whom did David send some of the plunder when he came to Ziklag?
questions.explanation: He sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, his friends, as a present from the plunder of Yahweh's enemies.
